question: Who is invoked to grant constant protection to both sides of the body?
premises: The supreme one is invoked with klīṃ-kṛṣṇa
The pair of sides is the object of protection
inference: The supreme klīṃ-kṛṣṇa always protects the pair of sides.
plain_english: May the supreme one, invoked as klīṃ-kṛṣṇa, always protect my pair of sides.
